IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.schemas WHERE name = 'logging')
BEGIN 
    EXEC('CREATE SCHEMA logging')
END
GO

-- 2. Create Unified Tracking Table
IF OBJECT_ID('logging.TrackingTable', 'U') IS NOT NULL
    DROP TABLE logging.TrackingTable;
GO 

CREATE TABLE logging.TrackingTable (
    Table_Name VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,           
    trading_pair VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,        
    Last_Processed_Timestamp DATETIME2,        
    Record_Count BIGINT,                       
    System_Update_Time DATETIME2 NOT NULL,     
    Full_refresh BIT DEFAULT 0                 
)
WITH (
    DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN,
    CLUSTERED COLUMNSTORE INDEX
);
GO

delete from logging.TrackingTable where trading_pair = 'ETCUSDT';

select * from logging.TrackingTable order by trading_pair;

delete from logging.TrackingTable WHERE trading_pair = '"BNBUSDT"'
  AND Table_Name = 'crypto_candles' and Full_refresh = 0;

INSERT into logging.TrackingTable (Full_refresh, Table_Name, trading_pair, System_Update_Time)
values (1, 'crypto_candles', 'SOLUSDT', '2021-01-01 00:00:00');

UPDATE logging.TrackingTable
SET Full_refresh = 'True'
WHERE Table_Name = 'crypto_candles';
